summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc., the Taiwan-domiciled Nasdaq-listed fintech operating as Owlting Group (OWLS), furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a commercial partnership rather than a special situation. Exhibit 99.1 states that Decaf, a global payments platform reporting US$48 million in monthly payment volume, has embedded OwlPay Harbor as licensed payment infrastructure behind Decaf Business and opened U.S. dollar account access to eligible non-U.S. incorporated companies and organizations. Decaf Business has been in production on Harbor since August 2026; Owlting earns fees on payment volume. No securities terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date were stated. The structural note is channel economics: Owlting captures volume-based revenue while Decaf owns customer onboarding and interface. Watch partner concentration and corridor expansion as the operative risk-arb angle.
